_spec: SNG-652 §5 — a category, a plain line of what it does, and a line of flavour for every feature kind in economy.holdFeatures.kinds. The mechanical numbers on screen are composed by the engine from the kind's own fields (yields, defence, watch, hands, residents, aura, pilgrims, upkeep), so they cannot drift from the rules; `what` is the words around them. Staged: `category` needs its reader (C20). | 2026-09-25 APPLIED to core/rules/economy.json holdFeatures; what lines rewritten as words only (the numbers are the engine’s, via featureDoes). The live file is now the authority; this is the record.

categories.muster: Muster & training — where a force is raised
categories.craft: Craft & learning — what can be done here
categories.travel: Travel & network — roads, relays and mounts
categories.sacred: Meaning — the sacred and the remembered

wall.what: Stone between you and whoever comes; it makes the hold harder to take.
wall.flavor: Nobody writes songs about a wall. Everybody who lived behind one remembers it.

barrier.what: A worked barrier across the approach; raiders have to get through it before they reach anything else.
barrier.flavor: It does not stop anyone. It decides where they have to go.

gate.what: A gate that closes, so the hold can be shut against the road.
gate.flavor: A gate is a question the hold gets to ask.

keep.what: The last room that holds. While it stands, a raid cannot take everything.
keep.flavor: When everything else has fallen, this is where the keeper stands.

ward_line.what: A standing ward-line, kept up by craft. It defends, and it feels things coming.
ward_line.flavor: You feel it before you see it: the air goes attentive at the edge.

moat.what: A moat or a ditch-and-bank (a kind of wall); anyone crossing it does so slowly.
moat.flavor: Dig it once and it keeps digging for you, every time someone has to cross it.

thorn_line.what: A grown thorn-line (a Rootkin wall). It defends, and it grows back.
thorn_line.flavor: The Rootkin do not build walls. They ask the hedge to disagree with strangers.

tower.what: A watchtower. The watch sees farther, and trouble is seen sooner.
tower.flavor: From the top you can see trouble a day before it arrives, which is the whole point.

sentries.what: Sentries — raised, bound or posted. Something here is always awake, and it costs to keep it so.
sentries.flavor: Something always awake. Whether it is alive is a local matter.

watch.what: People posted to look, so the hold sees what is coming.
watch.flavor: A watch is only as good as the person who never sleeps on it.

muster_yard.what: A muster yard, where a band can be raised and drilled.
muster_yard.flavor: Stamped earth and a post for the banner. Every army starts in a yard like this.

drill_ground.what: A drill ground (a kind of muster yard). Trains the people quartered here.
drill_ground.flavor: Sanded, and somebody who knows what to do with it.

barracks.what: Barracks, where a band is housed. Beds for soldiers, not for workers.
barracks.flavor: Forty cots and one opinion about how the blankets are folded.

mine.what: A mine. It brings raw material up out of the hill every pass the hold is doing well.
mine.flavor: The hill gives up what it has to whoever keeps asking.

quarry.what: A quarry. It cuts stone every pass, for walls and for sale.
quarry.flavor: Every wall in the district started here.

mill.what: A mill. It turns out raw material every pass.
mill.flavor: Water or wind or oxen; the stone goes round and the grain comes out.

workshop.what: A workshop. It makes mechanical parts every pass, and keeps working even while the hold moves.
workshop.flavor: Benches, vices, and a smell of oil that never quite leaves.

herd.what: A herd or a planting. It raises living stock every pass.
herd.flavor: Something grows here that did not grow here before.

kiln.what: A kiln or a lime-burn. It makes cut stone every pass.
kiln.flavor: It burns day and night, and the whole hold smells of it.

fishery.what: A fishery or a weir. It takes living stock from the water every pass.
fishery.flavor: The river pays a toll too, if you know how to ask it.

still.what: A still or a physic-garden. It makes medicines every pass.
still.flavor: Half the jars are remedies. The other half are why people visit.

lens_works.what: A lens-works. It grinds worked light every pass, and it is costly to keep.
lens_works.flavor: Glass ground until it bends the day the way you want it.

forge.what: A forge. Lets smiths make and mend weapons and armour here.
forge.flavor: The hottest place in the hold and the one everyone gathers round in winter.

smithy.what: A smithy. Lets gear be repaired here, even while the hold moves.
smithy.flavor: Horseshoes, hinges, and whatever broke yesterday.

laboratory.what: A laboratory. Lets alchemy and assay be done here.
laboratory.flavor: Everything labelled, and some of the labels are warnings.

scriptorium.what: A scriptorium. Lets documents be copied and kept here.
scriptorium.flavor: Quiet, careful hands, and ink that costs more than the paper.

school_room.what: A school-room. Lets people be taught here.
school_room.flavor: A room where someone is always asking why.

quarters.what: Quarters: homes for the people who work the hold, and room for more of them to work.
quarters.flavor: Somewhere to sleep that is not the floor of the workshop.

longhouse.what: A longhouse: homes for the hold's people, and more of them at work.
longhouse.flavor: Everyone eats at one long table, and every argument happens there too.

keepers_hut.what: A keeper's hut: a home for the keeper, and one more at work.
keepers_hut.flavor: One room, one bed, one lamp, and a view of the whole hold.

infirmary.what: An infirmary. It heals the people who live and work here.
infirmary.flavor: Clean linen, quiet voices, and a door that is never locked.

longship_deck.what: Deck space on a longship: homes for the crew, and it works while she sails.
longship_deck.flavor: Cleared, and worth more than it looks.

hearth.what: A hearth nobody lets go out. A little meaning, and now and then a pilgrim.
hearth.flavor: It has been burning longer than anyone here has been alive.

market.what: A market day. Goods can be traded here, it brings coin through, and traders come to it.
market.flavor: Once a week the whole district remembers this place exists.

relay_station.what: A relay station, the network's node. Messages pass through, and the service pays.
relay_station.flavor: Word arrives here from somewhere else, and leaves for somewhere farther.

waygate.what: A waygate, made rather than found: a passage to another place. Very costly to keep.
waygate.flavor: A door that is somewhere else on the other side.

stable.what: A stable or a boat-house. Keeps mounts and boats for travel.
stable.flavor: Hay, tack, and a horse that has opinions about you.

giant_lizard_den.what: A lizard-den (the Gearlands' kind of stable). Keeps lizard mounts.
giant_lizard_den.flavor: Warm stone, a heavy musk, and something that blinks sideways.

temple.what: A temple. It gives meaning, draws pilgrims steadily, and thickens the ground.
temple.flavor: People walk a long way to stand in a quiet room.

shrine.what: A shrine. A little meaning and the odd pilgrim, for almost nothing.
shrine.flavor: A stone, a candle, and a name.

temple_to_attending.what: A Temple to Attending. Deep meaning, endings attended here, and pilgrims.
temple_to_attending.flavor: Nobody here dies alone. That is the whole of the doctrine.

memorial.what: A memorial where names are kept. Meaning, and a pilgrim or two.
memorial.flavor: Every name read aloud once a year, whether anyone remembers why.

grave_ground.what: Tended grave-ground. Meaning, endings attended, and a visitor now and then.
grave_ground.flavor: Swept paths, and a bench for the people who visit.

reclamation_bowl.what: A reclamation bowl, where endings are attended. Deep meaning.
reclamation_bowl.flavor: A hollow in the ground where what ends is given back.
